result.notes: Fathom exposes a small REST API (meetings, transcripts, summaries, teams, webhooks) with self-serve API-key generation from user settings — no paid-plan gate mentioned in docs. Public OAuth apps are supported for third-party integrations (needed for marketplace listing, but not required for personal API key use). Rate limit: 60 calls/min per account across keys. Fathom also publishes its own official MCP server at api.fathom.ai/mcp, distinct from several community MCP wrappers found in registries. Did not verify actual pricing-tier gating beyond docs statements (no fetch of billing/pricing page), slightly lowering confidence.
result.one_liner: Fathom is an AI meeting-recording/notetaker app whose public REST API exposes meeting recordings, transcripts, summaries, and action items for building integrations.
